title: CP-40 Series Close-Coupled Centrifugal Pumps
key_sentences: The CP-40 series is designed for clean water circulation in heating, cooling and pressure boosting systems.
All wetted parts are made of stainless steel, which makes the pumps suitable for drinking water.
Performance values were measured with water at 20 °C in accordance with the tolerances of grade 2B.
For example, CP-40-220-V-S is a pump with a 2.2 kW motor, a silicon carbide seal and a casing in stainless steel 1.4301.
Changes to the controller settings take effect after the controller has been restarted.
The pump must not run dry, not even for a short time.

list_items.text: Heating and chilled water circulation in commercial buildings
1) Install the pump with the motor shaft horizontal or vertical, never with the motor below the pump.
2) Fit isolating valves on both sides of the pump to allow servicing without draining the system.
3) Fill the pump and the suction pipe with water before the first start.
